# Response fixture shapes

Examples below use field layouts documented by the providers. Values and model IDs are synthetic to make costs easy to verify.

- OpenAI Chat, Responses, Embeddings, Images: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/object ; https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/object ; https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/embeddings/object ; https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/images/object
- Anthropic Messages: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages
- Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#UsageMetadata
- Google Imagen: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/imagen-api
- Google Veo: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/veo-video-generation
- xAI Chat: https://docs.x.ai/docs/api-reference#chat-completions
